tasks.title: Workshop check-in choice
tasks.brief: A volunteer workshop expects 40 attendees for a one-day session. Choose between (A) QR self-check-in using attendees' phones and (B) staffed check-in on one shared tablet. Constraints: no paid services; venue internet may drop for several minutes; setup must take 45 minutes or less; preregistered attendees and walk-ins must be distinguishable; the operator must be able to see who has checked in during the event; names must be deleted within 7 days. Produce a compact decision artifact with: a constraint-by-constraint comparison of A vs B, one recommendation, three concrete risks with mitigations, and a five-step setup/run plan.
tasks.matchedRationale: Both registered tasks require choosing between two operational workflows under six explicit constraints, producing the same comparison/recommendation/risk/five-step-plan artifact, fitting a 20-minute collaborative episode without outside research.

tasks.title: Equipment checkout choice
tasks.brief: A volunteer event will lend 30 labeled devices for one day. Choose between (A) paper sign-out sheets and (B) a local browser form running on one shared laptop. Constraints: no paid services; venue internet may drop for several minutes; setup must take 45 minutes or less; every device has a unique asset ID; the operator must be able to see which devices are currently out; borrower alias plus checkout and return times must be deleted within 7 days. Produce a compact decision artifact with: a constraint-by-constraint comparison of A vs B, one recommendation, three concrete risks with mitigations, and a five-step setup/run plan.
tasks.matchedRationale: Both registered tasks require choosing between two operational workflows under six explicit constraints, producing the same comparison/recommendation/risk/five-step-plan artifact, fitting a 20-minute collaborative episode without outside research.

dimensions.description: How directly the artifact addresses the assigned deliverable and constraints.
How free the artifact is from material factual, logical, or requirement errors within the task.
How usable the artifact is without substantial additional reconstruction or rewriting.

operationalDefinitions.usefulConcurrentResult: A Commonline artifact arrives before the 20-minute episode ends and the pair uses it in the task before the episode ends.
operationalDefinitions.reconstructionTime: Whole seconds from resumption start until the pair states that it has enough task context to continue. Commonline is better only when its time is strictly lower than the matched baseline.
operationalDefinitions.criticalFalseApproval: Durable Commonline state represents an approval or accepted outcome that neither participant actually granted.
operationalDefinitions.acceptableDistraction: The pair reports the Commonline condition as acceptably non-disruptive and successfully operates the available silence/stop controls.
operationalDefinitions.preference: After completing and resuming both matched conditions, the pair selects Commonline, baseline, or no preference for another comparable task.
